revision.timing: The inactive-row stationarity policy was corrected after the local P80 U22 screen and before the 40-case production matrix.
revision.reason: A relative amplitude-change denominator is ill-conditioned for a response already classified as inactive near zero. The active-row 5 percent amplitude and frequency stationarity gates are unchanged.
revision.inactive_rule: Both adjacent half-window amplitudes must remain below 0.02 mean chord and their absolute difference must not exceed 0.005 mean chord. Frequency is not scored for an inactive broadband response.
revision.model_effect: No closure coefficient, force law, target, inactive amplitude ceiling, or active acceptance limit changed.

objective: Execute and quantify reproduction of all 20 Fu et al. IEA-10-MW response rows already used to train the semi-empirical closure. This protocol is not an independent validation protocol.

training_evidence.study: Fu et al. 2026 IEA-10-MW response matrix
training_evidence.role: All 20 amplitude rows are closure-training targets and reproduction scores.

training_evidence.study: Grinderslev et al. 2022 IEA-10-MW forced-motion and FSI response
training_evidence.role: One shared quadratic saturation landmark ratio, including the digitized 1.57 m zero-work amplitude and approximately 1.18 m FSI equilibrium. The full signed-work curve is not transferred.

training_evidence.study: Bidadi et al. 2024 seven-profile FFA-W3 fixed-body spectra
training_evidence.role: Profile-, incidence-, and frequency-dependent stationary forcing and correlated-load spatial weighting.
Speed- and configuration-dependent total passive damping correction, with no Fu response target used in the decay fit.

measurement.amplitude: sqrt(2)*RMS(y-mean(y)) over the stationary terminal window
measurement.frequency: dominant frequency of the same demeaned terminal signal

acceptance.digitization_uncertainty_role: reported separately and never added to the 30 percent pass threshold
acceptance.inactive_stationarity_rule: Both adjacent half-window amplitudes are <=0.02*cbar and their absolute difference is <=0.005*cbar; inactive frequency is not scored.
acceptance.configuration_peak_speed_rule: Among U=6,10,14,22 m/s, predicted and target maximum-amplitude speeds may differ by at most 4 m/s; U=18 m/s remains a separately reported training-linked diagnostic.
acceptance.aggregate_rule: All 40 execution receipts, stationarity gates, active amplitude and frequency gates, inactive gates, and configuration peak-speed gates must pass.

claim_boundary.supports: Quantified actual-QBlade reproduction of the Fu training matrix and verification of the composed native-aero, residual-spectrum, and motion-correlated bridge implementation.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Independent or blind validation, experimental validation, fatigue validation, H-VAWT validation, certification, or prediction outside the trained rows.
claim_boundary.next_validation: Freeze a target-excluded closure and evaluate a separate profile, orientation, or turbine VIV dataset without using its response values in fitting.
